title: Web: Home food
description: The `food` part of web_home: kcal eaten against the coach's daily target (never MFP's goal) and macros against their targets, as they stood that day. Every target is null before a phase is active or before its start. left = target - eaten (eaten counts as 0 when nothing is logged); negative = over.

build_up.description: How the day's target is built (phases.daily_target, as of the day): base at the step goal + step kcal + workouts (counted lifting sessions, fixed per-session values included) + activities (runs, wrestling, other and extra sessions) + surplus = total_kcal, exactly (rounding goes to steps_kcal, or to base_kcal without a step model; steps_kcal is 0 then). Null without a target (before a phase).

logged.description: partial: an earlier day suspected partly logged and not confirmed (today is never partial).

fiber.description: Fiber's target is a range (nutrition.fiber_g_per_kg x the macro reference weight): target_g is its low end.
